document.title: Manifest
document.summary: JSON manifest describing the Sample Knowledge Base: name, description, version 1.0.0, creation date 2026-10-13 and a file count of 7. It groups the files into two sub-knowledge-bases, HR Policies and File Type Validation, and records the mcp_ocr parser engine.

sections.title: Manifest
sections.text: manifest.json ``json { "kb_name": "Sample Knowledge Base", "kb_description": "A combined KB with HR policies and file type validation samples", "version": "1.0.0", "created_date": "2026-10-13", "file_count": 7, "sub_knowledge_bases": [ { "name": "HR Policies", "files": [ "user_manual.docx", "leave_policy.pdf" ] }, { "name": "File Type Validation", "files": [ "performance_metrics.csv", "quarterly_report.xlsx", "manifest.json", "config.xml", "requirements.txt" ] } ], "parser_engine": "mcp_ocr", "owner": "kb-admin" } `` kb_name: Sample Knowledge Base kb_description: A combined KB with HR policies and file type validation samples version: 1.0.0 created_date: 2026-10-13 file_count: 7 sub_knowledge_bases: [{"name": "HR Policies", "files": ["user_manual.docx", "leave_policy.pdf"]}, {"name": "File Type Validation", "files": ["performance_metrics.csv", "quarterly_report.xlsx", "manifest.json", "config.xml", "requirements.txt"]}] parser_engine: mcp_ocr owner: kb-admin
